items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 10:1
items.html: It was already explained above in answer 9. However, the matter of "part of it" means that the screen upon which the coupling was made for the sake of creation separated the direct light, part from part — that is, it separated the light of Hassadim from the light of Hochma. And this is called the light passing part of it through a screen. Therefore this light is called a light of offshoot and a new creation, as above in the adjacent answer. (Item 233).
